## Max Sum

http://acm.hdu.edu.cn/showproblem.php?pid=1003

```cpp
/*written by czk*/
/*O(n^2), Time Limit Exceed*/
#include <stdio.h>
#include <limits.h>
int main() {
    int T, t;
    scanf("%d", &T);
    for(t = 1; t <= T; t++) {
        int n, i;
        short a[100000];
        int max_sum = INT_MIN;
        int max_start, max_end;
        int start, end;
        scanf("%d", &n);
        for(i = 0; i < n; i++)
            scanf("%d", &a[i]);
        for(start = 0; start < n; start++) {
            int sum = 0;
            for(end = 0; end < n; end++) {
                sum += a[end];
                if(sum > max_sum) {
                    max_sum = sum;
                    max_start = start;
                    max_end = end;
                }
            }
        }
        printf("Case %d:\n%d %d %d\n", t, max_sum, max_start+1, max_end+1);
        if(t != T)
            printf("\n");
    }
}
```

```cpp
/*written by czk*/
/*O(n), AC*/
#include <stdio.h>
#include <limits.h>
int main() {
    int T, t;
    scanf("%d", &T);
    for(t = 1; t <= T; t++) {
        int n, i, a;
        int max_sum = INT_MIN;
        int max_start, max_end;
        int start, end, sum;
        scanf("%d", &n);

        start = 0;
        sum = 0;
        for(end = 0; end < n; end++) {
            scanf("%d", &a);
            sum += a;
            if(sum > max_sum) {
                max_sum = sum;
                max_end = end;
                max_start = start;
            }
            if(sum < 0) {
                start = end + 1;
                sum = 0;
            }
        }
        printf("Case %d:\n%d %d %d\n", t, max_sum, max_start+1, max_end+1);
        if(t != T)
            printf("\n");
    }
}
```
